title: SAGE-CP v2.1: code for conformal prediction across U.S. regions (BRFSS 2022)
description: Analysis notebook, executed Kaggle run, figure/table script and validation simulations for a component-wise evaluation of group-conditional and density-ratio-weighted conformal prediction under geographic holdout on the Kaggle BRFSS 2022 complete-case extract (246,022 respondents). The source data are not included; they are available from Kaggle (kamilpytlak/personal-key-indicators-of-heart-disease).
